findings.description: CSS variables defined in index.css (--font-hero-title, --font-section-heading) but components may still have Tailwind text-* classes that override them. Need to grep for text-4xl, text-5xl, text-6xl in components and verify they use style={{ fontSize: 'var(--font-*)' }} instead.
ProjectsSection modal close button uses inline style={{ zIndex: 9999 }} instead of var(--z-modal) from CSS architecture. Change to style={{ zIndex: 'var(--z-modal)' }} for consistency.
Audit claimed desktop nav links at 768px were h-10 (40px < 44px). Diff shows refactoring but need to confirm Navigation.tsx has h-11 applied at md: breakpoint, not just lg:.
Audit flagged 3D interaction button as py-2 (~32px height). Diff shows .tap-target class added, but need to confirm the class applies min-height: 44px and buttons render at ≥44px on 320px viewport.

DomeGallery uses custom lockScroll()/unlockScroll() that adds .dg-scroll-lock class, while ProjectsSection uses useScrollLock hook that sets body.style.overflow = 'hidden'. If DomeGallery modal opens inside ProjectsSection modal, scroll lock may conflict or double-lock body. Consider migrating DomeGallery to use useScrollLock hook.

Audit identified PhotoGallerySection modal with same scroll issues as ProjectsSection. Diff shows ProjectsSection fixed with useScrollLock, but no evidence PhotoGallerySection was updated. Need to check if PhotoGallerySection.tsx imports and uses useScrollLock hook.

Audit recommended min-h-[200px] for modal images in landscape mobile (height ≤500px) to prevent excessive cropping. Diff shows ProjectsSection modal but no explicit landscape media query or min-height on image section. May cause 38vh to shrink to ~150px on landscape phones.

Audit flagged 'Start a Dialogue' button overflowing at 320px. Recommendation was to show 'Contact' on mobile, full text on sm:. No evidence in diff that Footer.tsx was updated with responsive text. Button may still overflow.
Audit flagged tags with gap-[5px] (<8px minimum for touch). No evidence in diff that SkillsSection.tsx tags changed from gap-[5px] to gap-2 (8px). Tags may be too close for accidental double-tap.

Audit recommended AboutSection, EducationSection, SkillsSection bento grids use md:grid-cols-2 for tablets (768-1023px) instead of stacking single column. Diff evidence unclear; need to verify these sections have grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-12 pattern.
Refactoring touches 20+ files. Coder should have run tsc --noEmit or npm run type-check to verify no type errors introduced. No build log or type-check output in task artifacts.

Audit recommended object-position: 50% 20% on mobile to keep subject's face in frame. Diff shows HeroSection refactored but no evidence of responsive object-position change. Image may crop face on narrow screens.

Blueprint specifies 'max 2.5s' preloader duration. Diff shows setTimeout(() => { setProgress(100); }, 2500) which is correct, but if GSAP timeline takes longer than 2.5s total (progress animation + exit animation), preloader may exceed 3s. Exit animation is 0.5s, so progress must complete in 2s or less. Verify total timeline duration ≤2.5s.

Audit noted 'Cards transition to 2-column grid (md:grid-cols-2) but column balance uneven; some cards significantly taller.' No evidence in diff that grid-auto-rows: 1fr or min-height was added to balance card heights. Grid may have awkward gaps.
